Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan (Acme)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC/30-day trial so we can get your team unblocked:

Summary of goals (from today):
- Verify latency and cost at 1k QPS-equivalent traffic for your anonymized prompt set.
- Validate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) integration with your internal knowledge base for accurate policy responses.
- Measure quality delta vs current vendor for top-5 high priority flows.

Success criteria (proposal):
1) Avg inference latency <= 200ms p50 for production-like queries under 1k QPS batch simulation.
2) Response accuracy >= 92% on the 150-sample evaluation set (we'll draft a rubric).
3) No PII exfiltration incidents; audit logs enabled and retained for 30 days.

Proposed timeline & owners (high-level):
- Week 1 (kickoff): environment access, sample data ingestion, baseline eval — Owner: Marissa / Acme Eng lead (Jorge).
- Weeks 2-3: integration + tuning (Rafael to own runtime config and batching), weekly check-ins.
- Week 4: final readout, performance report, and next steps for Dedicated deployment (if successful).

Attachments: I attached a one-page POC success criteria spreadsheet and a suggested timeline graphic.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm success criteria above or note changes by EOD Thurs (1/14).
- Provide an S3 link or shared Drive folder with a small sample prompt set and 5 representative documents for RAG by next Tue (1/19).
- Confirm Jorge as the technical point of contact for integrations.

I’ll schedule the kickoff for Monday 1/18 (9-10am PT) pending your availability — can you confirm?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0198
marissa.cole@redwood.com
